scenario: settings-searxng (Research > Unlimited (Local) card) with Docker/OrbStack installed but its daemon not running
title: Settings SearXNG card tells a user whose Docker/OrbStack is installed but stopped that Docker 'isn't available on this machine' and to install it: the frontend branches on state only and ignores docker.cli_present/daemon_running and the sidecar's 'start Docker/OrbStack' detail
repro: Own sidecar :52845 from d38b5d1a source, OrbStack installed but not running: GET /search/searxng/status -> 200 {state:'not_installed_docker', detail:'docker CLI found but the daemon is not running — start Docker/OrbStack', docker:{cli_present:true, daemon_running:false}} (two runs, 16:45:04 and 16:45:21 IST). SettingsPanel.tsx:841-842 maps not_installed_docker to the chip 'Docker not found' and :967-978 renders 'SearXNG runs in a local Docker container, and Docker isn't available on this machine. Install Docker first — docs.docker.com/...'; grep for daemon_running|cli_present in src/ and types/ = 0 hits, although the manager contract (searxng_manager.py:13-16) says these flags exist to disambiguate 'Install Docker/OrbStack' vs 'Start it'. Distinct from fixed R15-LIFECYCLE-007 (PATH resolution, cli_present false): here the CLI is found and the UI drops the disambiguation.
